scripts.dev: concurrently -n WIDGET,HOST -c magenta,cyan "npm -w @apps/babylon-3d-widget run dev" "npm -w @apps/babylon-web-host run dev"
scripts.dev:compare: concurrently -n WIDGET,HOST,COMBINED -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm -w @apps/babylon-3d-widget run dev" "npm -w @apps/babylon-web-host run dev" "npm -w @apps/babylon-combined-app run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @apps/babylon-3d-widget run build && npm -w @apps/babylon-web-host run build
scripts.preview: npm run build && concurrently -n WIDGET,HOST -c magenta,cyan "npm -w @apps/babylon-3d-widget run preview" "npm -w @apps/babylon-web-host run preview"
scripts.dev:three: concurrently -n WIDGET,HOST -c green,blue "npm -w @apps/three-3d-widget run dev" "npm -w @apps/three-web-host run dev"
scripts.build:three: npm -w @apps/three-3d-widget run build && npm -w @apps/three-web-host run build
scripts.preview:three: npm run build:three && concurrently -n WIDGET,HOST -c green,blue "npm -w @apps/three-3d-widget run preview" "npm -w @apps/three-web-host run preview"
